### WION Golf Invitational at Qutab Golf Course, 14 November | Presented by VFS Global

Qutab Golf Course is the most challenging public golf course in India, and it makes you play with every club in the bag. On Saturday, 14 November, WION brings diplomats, corporate leaders and decision makers to Qutab for the WION Golf Invitational. The golf is followed by an evening on the clubhouse terrace, as part of WION's tenth anniversary.

### US President Trump Meets Qatar PM at White House | WION News

US President Donald Trump said on Monday there was momentum toward ending the war with Iran, as he declared that the country "militarily, is effectively over," but kept open the possibility of new strikes.

Trump met at the White House with Qatar Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani -- a key mediator in the Iran war. It was his first meeting with a foreign leader since his party's massive losses in the midterm elections.
